outages.gap_review.heading: Gap review queue
outages.gap_review.intro: A gap is a stretch with no data at all — not a confirmed outage. Review each one to decide whether the grid was actually down.
outages.gap_review.empty: No gaps need review in this range.
outages.legacy_review.heading: Legacy outage review queue
outages.legacy_review.intro: These outages were imported from the legacy log and flagged as suspected phantoms — short, low-confidence entries. Review each one to decide whether it was a real outage.
outages.legacy_review.empty: No legacy outages need review in this range.
outages.mains_strip.heading: Mains strip
outages.mains_strip.aria_label: Timeline of grid presence, outages, and unknown time over the selected range
outages.mains_strip.caption: Each colored segment is a stretch of time: solid color means the grid was confirmed present or absent for that whole stretch; a hatched segment means no data was recorded for it.
